title: Why products are not importing
excerpt: Find the common reasons products are not appearing after a connection is added.
author: FeedOps
content:
If products are not importing, start with the connection and source data.

## Common causes

- The source platform has not granted product data permissions.
- Products are unpublished, archived or excluded from the selected sales channel.
- Required attributes are missing from the source data.
- The first import is still processing.

## What to do next

Check the connection status, review import logs and confirm at least one active product is available in the source platform.
